title: Moving band to band; last band the Golden Rule, c. 1921-22
summary: Eddie says he drifted from band to band with no regular one, his last being the Golden Rule around 1921-22 with the same group. He criticizes a book's claims about a manager.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Me. I think. We're coming to the best band in New Orleans.
At that time. You know, some of the years. You're 20.
You know what I meant to do.

So. The last band I played in. Was the Golden Rule. That was the last band. That was in 19.
